name: Application Recovery
description: Restore a failed application to the last known-good process state without a blind reinstall.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read logs for a process this run already started.
Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.
Run a command on a configured server alias.

validation.rule: The recovery step was tied to the error that was read, and the process was checked afterward.
